entries.sql: SELECT * FROM unnest(ARRAY[1,NULL,3]::int[], ARRAY['a']::text[], ARRAY[true,false]) WITH ORDINALITY t(x,y,z,n)
SELECT * FROM unnest(ARRAY['null'::jsonb, NULL::jsonb, '{"a":1}'::jsonb]) WITH ORDINALITY t(v,n)
SELECT d._id, tag FROM things d, unnest(string_to_array(d._id || ' urgent', ' ')) AS tag WHERE tag = 'urgent' ORDER BY d._id
SELECT d._id, tag FROM things d CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(string_to_array(d._id || ' urgent', ' ')) AS tag WHERE tag = 'urgent' ORDER BY d._id
SELECT d._id, tag FROM things d JOIN LATERAL unnest(string_to_array(d._id || ' urgent', ' ')) AS tag ON true WHERE tag = 'urgent' ORDER BY d._id
SELECT d._id, t.v, t.n FROM things d LEFT JOIN unnest(CASE WHEN d._id = '1' THEN ARRAY[]::text[] ELSE ARRAY[NULL]::text[] END) WITH ORDINALITY t(v,n) ON true ORDER BY d._id
SELECT d._id, tag FROM things d, unnest(d.tags) AS tag ORDER BY d._id, tag NULLS FIRST
SELECT d._id, t.v, t.n FROM things d LEFT JOIN unnest(d.tags) WITH ORDINALITY t(v,n) ON true ORDER BY d._id, t.n
